narr: Strong to severe thunderstorms slowly moved across Weld County producing heavy rainfall and large hail. A storm chaser shared photos of a dry creek bed full of water running several feet deep across a road.
ev: Flash flooding is occurring with many county roads impassable due to up to 3 feet of water covering the roads. Exact locations and time are estimated.

Ongoing flash flooding over county roads is occurring. Multiple rain gauges reporting between 1.2 to 2.25 inches of rainfall over the past hour to hour and a half in the nearby area. Time is estimated.
